title: auto vacuum
text: auto vacuum. I chose the white.  It works as expected.  It sounds like a vacuum, however, I don't find it exceptionally loud as some others have reported and runs just a few seconds.  I removed all the carpet in my house and replaced it with lament flooring - so it is WAY easier to see the clutter and dust bunnies.  A quick sweep, into the auto vacuum and voile!  It's done.  One note, I did find that a broom I had with black bristles does NOT trigger the sensor.  Switched to a paler color bristle and it worked perfectly.  Not sure why that is, but - none the less. I keep it on auto.  Works flawlessly so far.  Ready to go at any moment. Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
